Since \(\frac12=\log\sqrt{10}\), the equation becomes
\[
\log\sqrt{(7x+3)(4x+5)}=\log(3\sqrt{10}).
\]
Thus
\[
\sqrt{(7x+3)(4x+5)}=3\sqrt{10}.
\]
Squaring:
\[
(7x+3)(4x+5)=90
\]
\[
28x^2+47x-75=0.
\]
\[
x=\frac{-47\pm\sqrt{47^2-4(28)(-75)}}{56}
=\frac{-47\pm103}{56}.
\]
So \(x=1\) or \(x=-\frac{75}{28}\).

Domain: \(7x+3>0\) and \(4x+5>0\). The negative solution fails, while \(x=1\) works.

\[
\boxed{1}
\]
